text: here is a bug; inside of the @cart/editor/ when: File -> New Mesh -> Cube -> Paint -> Confirm Atlas -> Remove Outliner; this retains the outliner in the stage but removes it from the outliners list
resolution: Root-caused the ghost cube: the outliner's part delete was composed from the interactive selection doors (__mesh_edit_select_group_range then __mesh_delete_selection), and the paint session makes those doors inert (req_2662) — so after Confirm Atlas the host op silently no-opped while AppFrame removed the row from modelParts regardless of the result. Fixed Zig-first: new structural host op meshDeleteGroupRange(lo,hi) in framework/gpu/3d.zig (masks faces by authored group id, reuses the same rebuild/journal path as delete-selection, exposed as __mesh_delete_group_range), ModelView.deletePartRange now calls it and only drops the range-mirror pair on a host-confirmed delete, and AppFrame.deletePart only removes rows whose geometry actually left the host (failed ops keep the row with the loud status). Needs a Zig rebuild to take effect; TSX + Zig verified by esbuild/ast-check, build left to the user per their loop.
